title: Hilbert-Smith Conjecture
exact_target: Must every locally compact group acting continuously and faithfully on a connected manifold be a Lie group, even when its action is only by homeomorphisms?

sources.citation: John Pardon, "Totally disconnected groups (not) acting on two-manifolds," manuscript of 6 July 2018 (surveying the Hilbert-Smith Conjecture; published in proceedings on Breadth in Contemporary Topology).
